data.body: Plan evidence corrected after implementation exposed stale baseline assumptions: frozen before-citations/word counts remain d6669496, while AST/runtime preservation now compares HEAD^ to HEAD and separately asserts that d6669496..HEAD^ contains exactly two legitimate _NON_MUTATING additions (get_local_id_map and _issue_local_id_property) in the one affected file. The corrected immutable-prose-only command passes on final authored commit 18a6cb3ce82e1f25dfb670642dd3018727be1fe8. Per operator instruction, verify_commands now contains the six focused local DD checks; Gerrit Verified +1 is the full repository-gate evidence. This material correction intentionally makes the plan attestation stale and will be recertified once, against the final merged SHA, before close.
